description: REQUIRES API KEY (sessions:write scope). Starts a remote session on a CONFIRMED Robotics & AI booking (SSH / Jupyter / VNC / API access). Returns the session access token — shown ONCE, store it securely — plus the connection URL and allocated specs. For METERED bookings the per-minute clock runs while the session is active; call rigshare_end_session (or end the booking) to settle for exact usage. Equipment that requires MFA cannot be started via API key — the renter must use the web app.
name: rigshare_start_session
title: Start remote session
